value.rationale: The finite-horizon single fixed-load problem is motivated by battery discharge with a fixed load and terminal deadline, not a parameterized exercise. The threshold beta E=2(2p-1) completely classifies opposite time responses and gives a deadline-independent matching rule across all kinetic prefactors. It is not supplied by the previously examined instantaneous-power calculation and offers a practical design boundary within the model.
